name: The Beacon
fieldReading: Don't chase the signal. Become it.
bio: A fixed point of warm light in the dark — one who doesn't chase the crowd but becomes the place it gathers.
sceneStory: On a spit of black rock ringed by churning, silver-capped waves, a keeper in a heavy coat raises a lantern high over their head with both hands, its amber beam cutting a wide bright road across the dark water. Far out along that road, a small three-masted ship with torn sails swings its bow around to follow the light in.
assignment: Don't chase the crowd — pick your spot and glow. What's meant for you comes to you.
